title: Choosing a support plan or help resource

kcs.statement: With the current plans, the cheapest plan for a critical-outage response need is Business Support+ for under 30 minutes, Enterprise Support for under 15 minutes or a designated TAM, and Unified Operations for under 5 minutes.
A how-to question with no paid plan goes to re:Post, the Knowledge Center or documentation, and a migration playbook comes from Prescriptive Guidance.
If the need is people to do the work, use an AWS Partner Network system integrator or AWS Professional Services; if it is packaged third-party software, use AWS Marketplace.

problem_ideas: Business-critical web store down, need a response within 30 minutes, budget-conscious: predict the cheapest current plan.
Response within 15 minutes plus a named AWS engineer: which plan, and which cheaper plan is the distractor?
A mission-critical payments platform needs an Incident Management Engineer within 5 minutes: which plan?
An SMB has no paid plan and a CloudFront caching question: route it.
A company needs 6 months of hands-on migration labor: partner, Professional Services or Support? Justify.
The same scenario is worded with legacy plan names (Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, Enterprise): pick the legacy answer and the current-plan equivalent.
